feeds.title: Loads of Music
feeds.description: Loads of Music is a blog from Switzerland. You'll find music-related news, concert photography, interviews, artist portraits and give aways!

feeds.title: Kekoas Korner
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nina the founder of Kekoas Korner. My passion is music and I love to share it with you. Being true to my blogs name I started my own blogging and Social Media / Community Management business.

feeds.title: Gotthard News
feeds.description: Hard Rock from Switzerland! Featuring: Nic Maeder, Leo Leoni, Marc Lynn, Freddy Scherer.

feeds.title: Montreux Jazz Festival News
feeds.description: News and Videos from the Montreux Jazz Festival. The Montreux Jazz Festival takes place for two weeks every summer in Switzerland, on the shores of Lake Geneva.

feeds.title: NeoBlog
feeds.description: neo.mx3 is the name of the new platform for contemporary and improvised Swiss music creation.

feeds.title: Pull n Way Blog
feeds.description: Latest info, releases, gigs, and more. Pull n Way is a Swiss Electro Pop project, represented by the singer and songwriter Mylène.

feeds.title: Metalhead Community
feeds.description: Metalhead Community is an independent digital media platform founded by Burak Gundogdu and dedicated to covering the music and culture of the metal underground. Here, you can read our top stories.

feeds.title: Swiss Music Awards
feeds.description: The Swiss Music Awards (SMA), the largest music award in Switzerland, serve to promote the national music scene and at the same time present its cultural diversity.

feeds.title: Swiss Music Export
feeds.description: Swiss Music Export's activities are focused on contemporary pop music. It supports the work of artists identified as having a realistic chance of success in their respective target market.

feeds.title: Swiss Artists Productions
feeds.description: Swiss Artists Productions (SAP) was created by a group of seasoned music producers, songwriters and entertainment specialists. Our goal is to take emerging artists on a ride toward a bright musical career.
